description: This file defines a custom exception class used within the 'investor' module of the Fineract project. It extends a base domain rule exception class and is likely thrown when attempting to create or modify a loan product attribute for an external asset owner that already exists.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributeAlreadyExistsException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a specific external asset owner loan product attribute already exists.

methods.name: ExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributeAlreadyExistsException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error message, an error code, and sets the HTTP status to FORBIDDEN.
